description: 一時集合場所、避難場所、避難所一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 墨田区. 【墨田区】一時集合場所、避難場所、避難所の一覧です。. Coverage: 墨田区. The portal files it under the publisher 墨田区. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
